text: Hello — quick note before the week gets away from me. I've been watering the raised bed by the fence; the tomatoes and basil are coming on well. I'll also turn the full compost bin and start a second one. Two jobs I can't get to: the apple tree wants pruning before the frost, and the water butt tap needs a new washer. Shall we split a seeds order: carrots, spinach, sweet peas? Thanks, Tom!
